data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 the syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of $901.524m (comparative). During 2024 the syndicate recorded a gross strengthening in prior year claims provisions of $58.972m (6.54% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse reserve reviews primarily in Non-Marine Liability (US casualty) and Marine & Energy Liability, together with adverse development across Aviation, Marine Hull and Offshore Energy. Natural catastrophe activity in 2024 (Hurricanes Helene, Milton, Beryl, Francine and flooding in Canada and Europe) and ongoing litigation trends in US casualty also contributed to movements. The reserve movement is disclosed explicitly in the technical provisions (note 18) as a gross increase in prior year estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: the 2024 calendar year result has been adversely impacted by the completion of reserving reviews to Non-Marine Liability and Marine & Energy Liability performed during the calendar year.

the calendar year result has also been impacted by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years from several classes, including Aviation, Marine Hull, Offshore Energy, Non-Marine Liability, and Marine & Energy Liability.
We completed a Non-Marine Liability review, specifically of US casualty exposures, following several large single plaintiff settlements we observed in the first quarter of the year.
We have also strengthened reserving in the Marine & Energy Liability class on the 2021 and prior years of account following adverse claims experience in the third quarter of the year.

The total net cost to the syndicate of these hurricanes and flooding events was more than the catastrophe allowance for the 2024 calendar year, driven by the frequency of events rather than the severity of any one event.

IBNR allowances for classes where there is potential for losses arising because of the ongoing Russia/Ukraine conflict, namely Aviation, Cargo, Marine Hull and Political Risk. The expected net cost of claims from this conflict is $4.5m.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and converted from the $'000 presentation to millions. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding comparative 2023 column). Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note 18 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross = $58,972k). The narrative sentence quoted for exact_reserve_text reports the NET deterioration ($28,642k) which reconciles to the gross and reinsurer share in the note; the JSON prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the GROSS figure per specification. Several LOB-level movements are described qualitatively in the report but not quantified by LOB; amounts for LOB movements are therefore null. Claims development triangle provided in the notes was used as supporting data.
